title: inboxmover: RecordRootTaskFailure is dead code and a second quarantine writer; ClaimLaneScope's error is always nil; a t.Skip contradicts its doc
summary: Found by comment-reduction batch 35 (2026-09-26) and reported without changing code. (1) RecordRootTaskFailure has no production caller. It is also a second writer of quarantine state beside the lifecycle path, so a future caller could make the two disagree. It cited 'ADR-0080 P2', which that ADR does not contain. (2) ClaimLaneScope's error return is always nil. (3) inboxmover_amplified_test.go skips TestReleaseCycleProcessing_EntirelyMissingProcessingDir with t.Skip, while decomposition/06-inboxmover.md claims the package has no t.Skip.
fix: Delete RecordRootTaskFailure and its bump lock, or make it the single quarantine writer, keeping one owner either way. Drop ClaimLaneScope's unused error. Un-skip or delete the skipped test, and correct the doc.
acceptance: Exactly one code path writes quarantine state
No function returns an always-nil error
The package has no t.Skip, or its doc names the one it has
